svg.title: 3D surface plot: z equals sine of open paren x close paren cosine of open paren y close paren
svg.desc: 3D surface plot titled “z equals sine of open paren x close paren cosine of open paren y close paren”. x axis “x”, from -3 to 3. y axis “y”, from -3 to 3. z axis, from -0.997 to 0.997. Colors stand for values from -0.997 to 0.997. z = sin(deg(x))*cos(deg(y)), for x from -3 to 3 and y from -3 to 3; z is lowest, -0.997, at x = -1.5, y = 0, and highest, 0.997, at x = 1.5, y = 0.
